summary: Iteration 12: tested the organizer Projects list and multi-project creation end to end (backend pytest plus Playwright UI). Acceptance criteria 1-12 all pass. Demo organizer lands on /projects and sees exactly 3 examples in order ('12-branch' Draft, 'Six-store' Draft, 'Warehouse' Needs information). The list did not grow after 2 reloads, 2 more sign-ins or 5 parallel first sign-ins. Each example has its own sites, dates, budget and stored sources; the source cards show 'Not read yet' and a Read button. New project dialog: the button is disabled while the name is empty; a double-click sent 1 POST; a failed POST shows the error and keeps the name and customer, and the retry reuses the same request_key. 6 parallel POSTs with the same key created 1 record. New projects open an empty 'Add the job details' workspace with no fixture data, and details saved manually persist after reload. Switching projects works, and the confirm dialog appears for unsaved edits on both the back link and the switcher. A Read started in Six-store finished in Six-store (12 facts) and nothing showed up in Warehouse. A partner link created in 12-branch shows 12-branch terms even after Six-store was selected or X-Project-Id pointed at Six-store; the partner responded and the answer persists after reload. A second firm gets 404 'Project not found for your business.' on project, history, readings, intake PUT, source POST and file download, and the UI shows the same message. An unpaid organizer gets 402 and is redirected to /pilot; a paid organizer creates several projects without checkout. The summary page shows the right project, and its back link returns to the same id. /project and /summary redirect to /projects. Reset on Six-store keeps the same URL/id and leaves 12-branch and the user's project unchanged; user projects have no reset button, and the API returns 400 for user projects and 403 for real organizers. Stepper reads Check/Draft/Invite/Decide, and the login logo is text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl. 5 minor UI issues found, no critical ones.

minor.issue: project_status runs version and partner_statuses queries for each project (N+1). Fine at the 200-row cap, but worth batching later.

ui_bugs.issue: For a project with 0 sites, the tab is forced to 'read'. IntakeTask remounts on every save (key=rev), so a user entering details manually is sent back to 'Paste a brief or add files' after each save and after reload. Cause: useState in IntakeTask.jsx line 46 ignores sessionStorage when sites.length is 0.

The switcher label is stale after renaming a project. The title shows 'Retry me RENAMED' but the switcher still shows 'Retry me', because ProjectBar fetches /projects only once on mount. Refetch it when the sheet name or rev changes, or use the sheet name for the selected item.

confirmLeave only guards ProjectBar back/switcher and the AppHeader Projects link. The Brand/logo link, My reviews, Sign out, browser reload or tab close (no beforeunload), and switching stepper steps (IntakeTask unmount calls setDirty(false)) all drop unsaved intake edits silently.
The Check step with the 'Paste a brief or add files' tab overflows horizontally by 2px (scrollWidth 392 vs 390). The Projects list, Draft, Invite and Decide steps have no overflow.

issues: Only the header Projects icon leads back; add a clear 'Back to projects' button in the card.

design_issues.screen: Check > Paste a brief / intake form
issues: Document date and Start date use the browser's native date picker (input type=date) instead of the shadcn calendar (existing before this round).

action_items: IntakeTask: keep the user's chosen tab (sessionStorage) after save and reload even when sites are empty; default to 'read' only on first open.
ProjectBar: refresh the switcher rows or label after saves that rename the project.
Extend the dirty guard: beforeunload, the Brand link, My reviews, Sign out, and stepper step changes while IntakeTask is dirty.
Fix the 2px horizontal overflow of the intake TabsList at 390px (e.g. w-full with flex-wrap or smaller text).
Optional: add a 'Back to projects' action on RouteDenied for 404 project.
critical_code_review_comments: Authorization is solid: get_project always filters on firm_id plus X-Project-Id, and review routes ignore X-Project-Id and use the link's project_id.
Keyed/Projects call setProjectId during render (a side effect in render). It works, but a useLayoutEffect or passing the id explicitly would be safer under concurrent rendering.

The NewProjectDialog request_key ref lives for the whole Projects page mount. That is fine for retries, but closing the dialog and creating a second project with a new name in the same mount would return the first project if the first create succeeded without navigating (it currently always navigates, so this is low risk).

Running backend/tests together with tests/test_billing_pilot.py in one pytest run makes 4 billing tests fail, because the backend/tests conftest auto-grants the pilot. Run them separately (each passes on its own: 67 and 16).

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 new tests; regression: backend/tests 67 pass, billing 16 pass when run separately)
success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all acceptance flows pass; 4 minor/medium UI issues)

test_credentials: Demo: Organizer button on /login (synthetic-demo). Paid real organizer created: test_paid_ui_iter12@example.com / Passw0rd!x (pilot_active set in Mongo).
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed registered firms and projects; demo sandboxes per random visitor_id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each Playwright browser run gets a new localStorage visitor_id, so a new demo sandbox, so projects created in a previous run are not visible. Project API names include ' (Synthetic)' (the frontend strips it). The 12-branch draft needs partners ticked via draft-include-<id> before draft-generate-button. Status becomes 'Awaiting partner review' once links exist. Re-verify the intake tab persistence, switcher label refresh, dirty-guard coverage and the 390px tab overflow.
